_about: Store settings the generator can't read from a repository: the file an app keeps its sign-in or key in (the store keeps it encrypted on the card) whether the app may use MiyooScale's proxy, a folder to install a replacement for an Onion app under, beside the original (keyed by the folder in its zip), and facts for its page. Keyed by owner/repo#Folder.

facts: From its own menu (Select) it can write the battery capacity, the hardware shutdown voltage and the capacity-learning switch into the power chip's registers; it does nothing to them unless chosen there.
